c2Search.prefilter: root K1 support on the rug flat field (20 mm) for stool feet, stand ends and sustain base; all-vertex controller azimuth span >= 30.5 deg (an upper bound of the unobstructed span)
c2Search.selectionRule: targets 81/81 each; unobstructed controller azimuth >= 30.5 deg (0.5 deg author margin over the builder assert); kick-pedal unobstructed fraction not below the v01 reference fraction (sample sets differ in size); then maximise the smaller of the throne-seat and sustain-pedal unobstructed fractions (both root recheck items); ties: the larger of the two, then nearest placement D (cx 1.30, cy -0.90, yaw -0.70). Revised once by the author after the first dry run, whose throne-first rule chose a sustain pedal at 59/116.
